summary: How the original shows a tooltip: the box, the per-frame update, the delay's clock, the in-game idler's two tooltip slots, and GuiTooltipText's fields.

addresses.name: CEU3Idler::Enter
addresses.comment: **Slot 3 of CEU3Idler: makes the one text box every tooltip is shown in.** Asks the gui (+0x60, slot 14) for the `ToolTip` text box of interface/core.gui - Arial14, tiles_dialog.tga, a 16 border, maxWidth 400 - keeps it at +0x5C and hides it. CInGameIdler::Enter calls it at 0x65D416 and the front end's slot 3 at 0x6EF7BE. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret` at 0x6445CE; the literal 'ToolTip' (0x15CD89C) is assigned at 0x644508; vtable.py --holding puts it in CEU3Idler slot 3 alone.

addresses.name: CEU3Idler::UpdateTooltip
addresses.comment:
**Every frame: the tooltip under the mouse into the box.** Reads the mouse (+0x64 slot 19); asks slot 20 for the GuiTooltipText; when the mouse moved, keeps the clock (slot 21, its slot 5) truncated to a whole second in 0x1BEA464; when the clock is now more than 1 past that, appends `delayed` under "
--------------
" and `delayed_extra` under "
--------------" (only when text precedes) and "
"; skips the rest when equal to the text kept at +0x40; trims 
	 and space at both ends; empty hides the box; else wraps it at box +0xA8 - 3 * box +0xAC with a height of 2000 and sets it with GuiObject_textBoxType::SetTextToFit; then places it at `position`, less its height when `below` is false, pulled back inside the right and bottom edges of the screen (slot 22) and not the left or top. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x644B60..0x644FDC, `ret 4`; called from CInGameIdler::Update at 0x656702 and the front end's slot 1 at 0x6EE8F9. The two dash literals are 0x15CD8A4 and 0x15CD8B8.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::GetTooltip
addresses.comment: **Slot 20: the tooltip under the mouse.** Empty when g_TooltipsEnabled is 0. An interface element under the mouse (the gui's +0x98) is asked through slot 109, and when its `delayed_extra` is empty and the element's slot 39 answers its shortcut, `delayed_extra` becomes the localised SHORTCUT ('§WShortcut: §Y') and the shortcut. Otherwise, over the map (input slot 17), the province under the mouse (+0x1DD4) is asked through its slot 3 - ProvinceTooltip_Build - placed 50 left of and 20 above the mouse with `below` false; nothing there gives an empty tooltip. The result is kept in g_InGameTooltip. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and listed 0x6627D0..0x662C30, `ret 4`; the slot 109 call is `call [edx+0x1B4]` at 0x662938; the map offsets are `add word [esp+0xC], -0x32` and `-0x14` at 0x662B83.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip(CInGameIdler* this, GuiTooltipText* out, void* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: **Slot 109: an interface element's tooltip.** Keeps the element at +0x184, asks the list at +0xD20, the windows at +0x1358 (0x764F40), +0x135C (0x762670), +0x1360 (0x73BF20), +0x1D48 (0x6D2E80), +0x1D4C (0x6D1DE0), the view at +0xD10, the orders view, then some sixty element names (closebutton CLOSE, mapmode_N MAPMODE_N, zoom_in, zoom_out, the multi-unit buttons...), then CInGameIdler_NamedElementTooltip. Places the point: the element's slot 24 plus the tooltip's `position`; when `below` and its y is beyond 0.8 of the screen's height, `below` becomes false; otherwise y += 64. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled 0x6C5290..0x6C952B, `ret 8`; the placement at 0x6C9471; 0.8 is the double at 0x160A3E0. Each window's routine named here is unread.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_NamedElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CInGameIdler_NamedElementTooltip(void* element@ECX, CInGameIdler* idler@stack:4, GuiTooltipText* out@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment: The last of CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip's questions, by the element's name (+8): `topbar` (the top bar's), the message categories, the speed buttons, on_complete_impact, on_complete_icon, trait_icon (name, description in `delayed`), technology icons (TC_BUILD_COST_AND_TIME), message_dialog (CEU3Idler_MessageDialogTooltip), else CInGameIdler_ViewTooltip; then trims `text` and `delayed`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and listed 0x6C43B0..0x6C5280, three `ret 8`; the element is ECX (`lea eax, [edi+8]` at 0x6C4443 is its name); the trims at 0x6C51DF and 0x6C5221.

addresses.name: CEU3Idler_MessageDialogTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CEU3Idler_MessageDialogTooltip(CEU3Idler* idler@ECX, void* element@stack:4, GuiTooltipText* out@ESI) @EAX
addresses.comment: A `message_dialog` element's tooltip: walks the list at idler +0xA0 for the entry whose slot 2 owns the element and has its slot 3 fill `out`; none leaves it empty. That +0xA0 is the open message dialogs is inferred from the name it serves. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; two `ret 4`; reads ESI before writing it.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_ViewTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CInGameIdler_ViewTooltip(void* element@stack:4, CInGameIdler* idler@EAX, GuiTooltipText* out@EDI) @EAX
addresses.comment: The fallback of the fallback: with a builder window open (+0x1CE0) its sort column's label (BuildBuilderSortColumnLabel); else, when 0x665280 says a country view is open, that view's slot 10 (the view at +0xD00[+0xCFC]) - the production and technology screens' tooltips come through here; else empty. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; three `ret 4`; reads EAX and EDI first.

addresses.name: CFrontEnd::GetElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CFrontEnd::GetElementTooltip(CFrontEnd* this, GuiTooltipText* out, void* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: Slot 109 of the front end: only `gamesetup` (the game setup view's slot 6) and `micro`; places the point as CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip does. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 6.

addresses.name: CButton::GetPosition
addresses.comment: Slot 24 of a button: the float pair of the drawable at +0x88, truncated to two shorts - the button's corner, which the drawable was placed at from +0x90/+0x92 as the button was set up (0xAA1084). What a tooltip's point is measured from. CGraphicalTableLedger's slot 24 answers (0, 0). The class is inferred: CEU3Minimap (CIcon, CButton) is the only RTTI table holding it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 5.

addresses.name: GuiObject_textBoxType::SetPosition
addresses.comment: Moves a text box: keeps the two shorts at +0xB8 and, by the orientation at +0xCC (0 to 6), adds the parent's width (+0xD0), half of it, or half less half the box's width (+0xA8) when +0xC4 is 2, and hands the result to the drawable at +0x4C (slot 51). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.

addresses.name: GuiObject_textBoxType::SetTextToFit
addresses.comment: SetText (VA 0xA87F30) with **no height**: the same comparison with +0xD8, the same assignment, but the drawable's slot 60 is handed the width word +0xA8 and 0 where SetText hands slot 61 +0xA8 and +0xAA - so the box grows to its text and is not held to its maxHeight. How the tooltip box is filled. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0xA87FD0..0xA88054, bare `ret`; pushes `0` at 0xA88030 between +0xA8 and +0xAC.

addresses.name: TrimWhitespace
addresses.comment: `out` = `text` without \n, \t, \r and space at either end (the set at 0x15FC548, length 4); all of it whitespace gives "". See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Listing; FindFirstNotWhitespace and FindLastNotWhitespace with 4, then a substring.

addresses.name: FindFirstNotWhitespace
addresses.comment: Index of the first character not in the first `setLength` of "\n\t\r ", or -1. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0xA5C2B0..0xA5C318: memchr over 0x15FC548 for each character.

addresses.name: FindLastNotWhitespace
addresses.comment: The same from the end. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.

addresses.name: String_AppendCString
addresses.comment: `*this += text`: strlen then appendChars. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 4.

addresses.name: String_Equals
addresses.comment: Whether two strings are equal: compare the shorter length, then the lengths. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.

addresses.name: StubPlatform_MakeClock
addresses.comment: Slot 1 of the stand-in platform factory (vftable 0x15FDF60): a 4-byte clock, vftable 0x15FDCFC, whose slot 5 is `fldz; ret` - always 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 3.

addresses.name: Platform_MakeClock
addresses.comment: Slot 1 of the platform factory installed at start-up (vftable 0x1605328): a 0x30-byte CHighPerfWinClock. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 3.

addresses.name: CHighPerfWinClock::CHighPerfWinClock
addresses.comment: vftable 0x16086C8; the source file is named highprefwinclock.cpp. Asks for the performance frequency, keeps 1/frequency at +0x18 (fld1; fdivrp at 0xB4FA6C), base +0x10 at 0 and stopped (+0x28 = 1). The class name is ours, from the file's. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 3.

addresses.name: CHighPerfWinClock::GetSeconds
addresses.comment: Slot 5: stopped, the base (+0x10); else (counter now - counter at start (+8)) * the scale (+0x18) + the base - seconds. A global switch at 0x1A858C4 makes it answer +0x20 instead. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 3.

addresses.name: g_TooltipsEnabled
addresses.no_signature: A global byte, not a function.
addresses.comment: Byte, initially 1. 0 stops every tooltip (CInGameIdler::GetTooltip, GetElementTooltip). The console command `tooltips` flips it (0x441723) and says 'Tooltips are now turned OFF.' or 'ON.' See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: The data reads 01 at 0x170AD31; 0x44175D..0x441766 is `cmp; sete; mov`.

addresses.name: g_TooltipStillSince
addresses.no_signature: A global int, not a function.
addresses.comment: The clock, truncated to a whole second, when the mouse last moved. CEU3Idler::UpdateTooltip shows a tooltip's delayed half once the clock is more than 1 past it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 3.

addresses.name: g_TooltipMouseX
addresses.no_signature: A global float, not a function.
addresses.comment: The mouse's x as last seen by CEU3Idler::UpdateTooltip, a float. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.

addresses.name: g_TooltipMouseY
addresses.no_signature: A global float, not a function.
addresses.comment: The mouse's y as last seen by CEU3Idler::UpdateTooltip, a float. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 2.

addresses.name: g_InGameTooltip
addresses.no_signature: A global GuiTooltipText, not a function.
addresses.comment: A static GuiTooltipText: the last tooltip CInGameIdler::GetTooltip made, which it returns a copy of. Destroyed at exit by 0xD23710. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 4.

addresses.name: g_ShortcutText
addresses.no_signature: A global Hoi3CString, not a function.
addresses.comment: The localised SHORTCUT ('§WShortcut: §Y'), rendered on the first shortcut and kept. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Rendered into at 0x662A07, guarded by bit 2 of 0x1BEBDA4.

addresses.name: g_random_object
addresses.comment: **A platform factory, not a lock or a debug hook.** At start-up 0xA56470 (called once, from the runtime's start-up code) installs a 0x18-byte factory with vftable 0x1605328 here (0xA57374); every other writer - 317, inlined into each user of the random generator - makes a 4-byte stand-in (vftable 0x15FDF60) only when it is empty. Slot 1 makes a clock (the real one a CHighPerfWinClock in seconds, the stand-in's always 0), which is how each idler gets the clock the tooltip's delay runs on; slot 9 answers whether a file exists (TextureHandler_ReloadEntry). The random functions only make sure it exists. The name is kept, and is a misnomer. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: The 319 writes of 0x174DA90 in .text: 317 follow `mov dword [eax], 0x15FDF60`, one stores 0 in an exception path (0x85D6B9), and 0xA57374 stores the object 0xB08500 built (vftable 0x1605328).
addresses.revises: The comment called it a stateless object made before each draw, 'a lock or a debug hook holder'; it is the platform factory, installed at start-up. Name kept.

struct_fields.name: delayed
struct_fields.comment: Shown once the mouse has been still, under a line of fourteen dashes. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.
struct_fields.revises: Renamed from second: what it is.

struct_fields.name: delayed_extra
struct_fields.comment: Shown with `delayed`, under its own line when anything precedes it; where a button's shortcut goes. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.
struct_fields.revises: Renamed from third: what it is.

struct_fields.name: position
struct_fields.comment: Two shorts, x low: an offset the element's corner is added to, or on the map the point itself. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x6C9471 adds slot 24's shorts to it; 0x662B9C stores the map point.
struct_fields.revises: Renamed from number: what it is.

struct_fields.name: below
struct_fields.comment: True: the box hangs below the point; false: it stands above it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x644ECF: when 0, the box's height is taken off y.
struct_fields.revises: Renamed from flag: what it is.

struct_fields.name: tooltip_text
struct_fields.comment: A CEU3Idler member: the tooltip text last put in the box, trimmed. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.

struct_fields.name: tooltip_box
struct_fields.comment: A CEU3Idler member: core.gui's ToolTip text box, made in CEU3Idler::Enter. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.
struct_fields.evidence: Written by CEU3Idler::Enter (0x6444E0) from the gui's slot 14; read throughout UpdateTooltip.

struct_fields.name: input
struct_fields.comment: A CEU3Idler member: the input object - slot 19 the mouse's position, slot 17 whether it is over the map. The class is not named. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.

struct_fields.name: clock
struct_fields.comment: The idler's clock, made and started in CInGameIdler::Enter (0x65A904, 0x65A928) from g_random_object's slot 1; slot 21 returns it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.

struct_fields.name: hovered_province
struct_fields.comment: The province under the mouse, as its second table (slot 3 is ProvinceTooltip_Build). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.
struct_fields.evidence: GetTooltip calls its slot 3 at 0x662B41 and places the tooltip at the mouse.

struct_fields.name: pdx_tooltip
struct_fields.comment: The localisation entry the file's pdx_tooltip names, looked up as the file is read; a missing key builds a message and frees it unlogged. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.

struct_fields.name: pdx_tooltip_delayed
struct_fields.comment: The localisation entry pdx_tooltip_delayed names. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tooltips.md.

slots_noted: The platform factories (0x15FDF60, 0x1605328) and the clocks (0x15FDCFC, 0x16086C8) have no RTTI; the stand-in clock's slot 5 (0xB50610, fldz) is folded across 30 tables and is not named.
notes: Nothing here was watched in a running game.
